Your Cloudflare Worker domain, e.g. name.account.workers.dev.
Separate several domains with commas.
YouTube traffic goes through it

first_run.title: Proxy is running in the system tray
first_run.how_to: How to enable the YouTube bypass:
first_run.step1: 1. Right-click the tray icon → “Settings...” → Cloudflare Worker: enable it and enter your Worker domain.
first_run.step2: 2. Click “YouTube proxy” in the tray menu (or click the icon) — Windows will get an auto-config script. When the app is closed, the internet works as usual.
first_run.step3: 3. Restart your browser and open YouTube.
